rationale: All acceptance criteria pass (AC1-AC6). The diff correctly adds the two missing label/message tests inside the existing azuredevops credential fields describe block, and settingsUIConfig.ts carries label: 'Hostname' and required('Hostname is required'). No blocking findings. Edge-case lens flagged Yup .url() rejecting on-premises bare hostnames — this concern is pre-existing (introduced in the prior field-ordering commit, already reviewed and approved with a defer classification). The hostname rename does not worsen the issue and the ticket explicitly required no changes to underlying logic. All three lenses ran and produced usable output.
